transcript:
This is NPR News Now, the latest headlines every hour.
Live from NPR News, I'm Lakshmi Singh.
President Trump takes a stage of back-to-back rallies today in Texas.
His latest stop through GOP strongholds across the country.
With just a week left until election day, polls indicate a tight Senate race in Texas
between Republican state AG Ken Paxson and Democratic state lawmaker James Tallarico.
The latest NPR/PBS news mayor's poll sheds light on the issues driving voters generally
to the polls in these midterm elections.
NPR's Domenico Montanar reports that the economy again tops the list, but there are
other factors close behind.
It's no secret that the cost of living is a strain on Americans.
It drove the 2024 presidential election, and it's the main factor in these midterms.
A third of respondents say they've experienced financial hardship in the past year, and four
in ten say their personal finances have gotten worse.
But close behind the economy and prices is the top issue in the survey, is preserving
democracy, which was number one for Democrats, and a close second for independents.
For Gen Z and millennials, though, groups Democrats need to be in their corner in this
midterm election.
It was overwhelmingly the economy, more than double those who said preserving democracy.
Immigration, meanwhile, is still the animating issue for MAGA supporters.
Domenico Montanaro, NPR News, Washington
polls have just closed in Israel in what many there call the most important election
in the country's history.
Here's NPR's Kat Lonsdorf.
It was the highest voter turnout in Israel in decades.
Votes are now being counted in the first national election since the Hamas attacks in 2023 and
the resulting wars in Gaza and the region.
Initial exit polls are expected shortly.
At stake is whether or not Israel's longest serving prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu,
who has increasingly anchored his political survival to the far right, will remain the
leader of the country.
His main challenger is center-right, Gadi Ison, a former Israeli military chief of staff.
Many Israelis have seen this election as critical for the country, with an outcome that has
major significance for Israel's relations with the U.S., the region, and the world.
The final vote will not be certified for several days, and in the winter it will need to form
a governing coalition, something that's not guaranteed.
Kat Lonsdorf, NPR News.
The nation's organ donation system is making a controversial change to a rule that was
designed to protect the safety of potential donors, whose NPR's Rob Stein.
The change is being made by the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network, which oversees
the nation's organ system.
The move will relax what has been a strict firewall between the doctors caring for patients
in the hospital and the organ procurement team standing by to try to retrieve their organs.
The change is part of a set of new policies designed to boost organ donations and minimize
errors, but critics worry it could put pressure on family members to discontinue care and
deepen distrust in the organ system.
Rob Stein, NPR News.
This is NPR.
The parents of Alex Preti, the Minneapolis nurse who was shot and killed by federal immigration
agents in January, accused the Trump administration of withholding evidence from local investigators.
From the family's first public remarks about the investigation since Preti's death, the
victim's father, Michael, tells the Justice Department to "stop shielding Alex's killers."
In a statement to news organizations, the Justice Department says that communications
with the family don't typically occur during an investigation, but happen at a later stage
of a case.
Last year's Super Bowl halftime performer has been announced, and it's someone with close
ties to the event.
Come February, Jay-Z will take center stage, NPR's Isabella Gomez-Admiento reports.
Jay-Z recently closed out his Jay-Z 30 tour celebrating the 30th anniversary of his debut
album "Reasonable Doubt" at the SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.
He'll be back in just a couple of months to headline the Super Bowl halftime show.
His wife, Beyonce, has performed at the Super Bowl twice, including as a headliner in 2013.
Jay-Z has been helping produce and curate the halftime show since 2019, NFL commissioner
Roger Goodell told Jay-Z to take the stage whenever the moment felt right.
This year, Jay-Z has been celebrating his legacy with the anniversary stadium tour and
an HBO docu-series about his career, so the time has finally come.
Isabella Gomez-Admiento, NPR News.
